title: Advanced Time Expressions
description: Через, назад, за + acc, на + acc for duration
intro: Russian time expressions use different prepositions for different meanings. ЧЕРЕЗ + accusative = 'in (future)': через час (in an hour). НАЗАД = 'ago': час назад (an hour ago). ЗА + accusative = 'within/in the span of': за час (within an hour, completed). НА + accusative = 'for (intended duration)': на час (for an hour, planned). These distinctions are crucial for expressing time relationships accurately.
rules: Через + acc = in (future): Я приду через час. (I'll come in an hour.)
Noun + назад = ago: Он уехал два дня назад. (He left two days ago.)
За + acc = within/completed in: Я сделал это за час. (I did it in/within an hour.)
На + acc = for (planned duration): Я приехал на неделю. (I came for a week.)
examples: Поезд отправляется через 20 минут. (The train leaves in 20 minutes.), future
Это случилось много лет назад. (This happened many years ago.), past
Она прочитала книгу за два дня. (She read the book in two days.), completed within
Мы приехали в Москву на месяц. (We came to Moscow for a month.), intended stay

items.prompt: Я позвоню тебе _____ час. (I'll call you in an hour.)
items.promptEnglish: I'll call you in an hour.

items.prompt: Он приехал два дня _____. (He arrived two days ago.)
Я сделал домашнее задание _____ полчаса. (I did my homework in half an hour.)
items.promptEnglish: I did my homework in half an hour.

items.prompt: Мы приехали в отпуск _____ две недели. (We came on vacation for two weeks.)
items.promptEnglish: We came on vacation for two weeks.

items.prompt: Встреча начнётся _____ 15 минут. (The meeting will start in 15 minutes.)
items.promptEnglish: The meeting will start in 15 minutes.

items.prompt: Она выучила стихотворение _____ один вечер. (She learned the poem in one evening.)
items.promptEnglish: She learned the poem in one evening.

items.prompt: Это было давно, много лет _____. (That was long ago, many years ago.)
items.promptEnglish: That was long ago, many years ago.

items.prompt: Он уехал в командировку _____ месяц. (He went on a business trip for a month.)
items.promptEnglish: He went on a business trip for a month.

items.promptEnglish: The film will end in two hours.

blanks: Он прочитал эту книгу _____ три дня. (He read this book in three days.)
Это было два года _____. (That was two years ago.)
Я приду _____ час. (I'll come in an hour.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: За = completed within; назад = ago; через = in (future time)
hints: Completed within a time period — which preposition?
Looking back in time — which word means 'ago'?
Future time point — which preposition means 'in'?
explanations: За + accusative = completed within: за три дня (in/within three days).
Назад = ago: два года назад (two years ago).
Через + accusative = after/in (future): через час (in an hour).
